## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -17.44%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND and Credit Spread/HYG signal stress (HYG (1W: +0.17% | 1M: +0.67%) → flat ABOVE TREND; LQD (1W: -0.03% | 1M: -0.20%) → flat BELOW TREND) — mixed confirmations supporting NEUTRAL.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear easing: VXX (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -17.44%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND. Credit stress nudging up: Credit Spread (1W: +0.41% | 1M: +0.75%) ↑ rising and HYG/LQD mixed — CPER/GLD reflation signal also present with CPER (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +8.27%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral overall: SPY/TLT ratio (1W: -0.24% | 1M: +1.86%) → flat CORRECTION and Dollar modestly firmer (Dollar proxy recovery) with yields little changed; TLT (1W: -0.39% | 1M: -1.43%) → flat BELOW TREND so duration not yet signaling clear relief.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Narrow leadership: Energy and Communications breadth positive while Tech and Financials show short-term weakness. XLE (1W: +0.47% | 1M: -1.25%) RECOVERY and XLU (1W: +0.52% | 1M: -3.60%) RECOVERY showing relative strength, while XLK (1W: -1.36% | 1M: +0.71%) CORRECTION and XLF (1W: -1.19% | 1M: +3.92%) CORRECTION show mixed momentum — style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US muted: SPY (1W: -0.88% | 1M: +0.54%) CORRECTION. EM/Europe outperforming on recent basis: EEM (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +2.23%) ABOVE TREND and VGK (1W: +0.00% | 1M: +4.04%) NEUTRAL, while China FXI (1W: -0.62% | 1M: -2.36%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation cooling: IWM (1W: -2.35% | 1M: +0.56%) CORRECTION and ARKK (1W: -4.46% | 1M: -0.79%) BELOW TREND; IBIT (1W: +0.00% | 1M: +2.37%) NEUTRAL — VXX decline suggests lower near-term fear but speculative flows remain subdued.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodities leadership in reflation: CPER (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +8.27%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND and DBB (1W: +2.64% | 1M: +7.06%) ABOVE TREND; GLD (1W: -4.19% | 1M: +1.68%) CORRECTION showing profit-taking in gold.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed to constructive: XLE (1W: +0.47% | 1M: -1.25%) RECOVERY while oil (BNO (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -2.98%) BELOW TREND) remains soft; natural gas UNG (1W: -4.96% | 1M: -19.40%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND and a clear weak spot.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: CPER (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +8.27%) ABOVE TREND and VXX (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -17.44%) BELOW TREND give partial risk-on signals. DIVERGENCE: Major divergence across core risk proxies (SPY (1W: -0.88% | 1M: +0.54%) CORRECTION, XLK (1W: -1.36% | 1M: +0.71%) CORRECTION, XLF (1W: -1.19% | 1M: +3.92%) CORRECTION) — suppress strong directional calls.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposures to reflation/comms/EM: CPER (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +8.27%) ABOVE TREND and EEM (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +2.23%) ABOVE TREND showing strength; reduce exposure to highly momentum-dependent tech: XLK (1W: -1.36% | 1M: +0.71%) CORRECTION and speculative ARKK (1W: -4.46% | 1M: -0.79%) BELOW TREND; bonds neutral-to-cautious with TLT (1W: -0.39% | 1M: -1.43%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Commodities/Materials via CPER (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +8.27%) ABOVE TREND and DBB (1W: +2.64% | 1M: +7.06%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: Technology via XLK (1W: -1.36% | 1M: +0.71%) CORRECTION and China equities via FXI (1W: -0.62% | 1M: -2.36%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Copper/industrial metals CPER (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +8.27%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -4.96% | 1M: -19.40%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND and oil BNO (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -2.98%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency threshold) — VXX (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -17.44%) BELOW TREND; HYG/LQD parity ~0.80 (credit health) — HYG (1W: +0.17% | 1M: +0.67%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.03% | 1M: -0.20%) BELOW TREND; XLK/XLF ~2.0 (growth vs value pivot) with XLK (1W: -1.36% | 1M: +0.71%) CORRECTION and XLF (1W: -1.19% | 1M: +3.92%) CORRECTION.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL: Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive.  
CPER (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +8.27%) ABOVE TREND and EEM (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +2.23%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength.  
Key risk is rising credit stress and sector divergence — monitor HYG (1W: +0.17% | 1M: +0.67%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.03% | 1M: -0.20%) BELOW TREND and XLK (1W: -1.36% | 1M: +0.71%) CORRECTION.
